findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization with pickle
 * @description Using pickle to deserialize untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/rich-unsafe-pickle
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization using pickle, marshal, or shelve that could lead to arbitrary code execution

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description Using unsanitized user input in file paths can allow attackers to access arbitrary files
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/rich-path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["open", "read_text", "read_bytes", "write_text", "write_bytes"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may be vulnerable to path traversal if user input is not validated."
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities where user-controlled input is used in file operations without proper validation

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name HTML Injection
 * @description Generating HTML with unsanitized user input may lead to XSS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/rich-html-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-079
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call.getFunction().asExpr().(Attribute).getName() = "write" and
    exists(DataFlow::Node arg | 
      arg = call.getArg(_) and
      arg.asExpr().toString().matches("%html%")
    )
  ) or
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("html").getMember("escape").getACall()
  )
select call, "HTML generation that may be vulnerable to injection if user input is not properly escaped."
findings.hypothesis: HTML injection vulnerabilities in export functionality where user-controlled content is written to HTML without proper escaping
